description:
But I wasn't wrong 😤

In my last video talking about the Windows security feature "Smart App Control", which you can now finally enable and disable at will, I got a lot of pushback. But it seemed to be all people complaining about stuff that wasn't really true. So in this video I clear up stuff that I didn't explain well in that video.
